column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for the storefront and the back office (specs/150, #293).
# Every rule that passed on 2026-10-05 is FAIL, so a regression fails the zap workflow. Each finding of the first
# round carries its decision: WARN = known and tracked by the named issue; IGNORE = not applicable, with why.
# Read by zap-baseline.py -c; only the first two columns are used, the third is for people.

column3: (Anti-clickjacking Header) - fixed by #294 (specs/151), must not come back
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing) - fixed by #294 (specs/151), must not come back
(Information Disclosure - Sensitive Information in HTTP Referrer Header)
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments) - Not applicable: matches the words admin and db in minified code (a route regex, a variable), not comments - specs/150 D4
(HTTP Server Response Header) - fixed by #294 (specs/151), must not come back
(Server Leaks Information via "X-Powered-By" HTTP Response Header Field(s))
(Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set) - fixed by #294 (specs/151), must not come back
(HTTP to HTTPS Insecure Transition in Form Post)
(HTTPS to HTTP Insecure Transition in Form Post)
(Content Cacheability) - Intended: hashed /assets/* cached for a year, index.html and /app-config.js no-cache (verify-storefront-image.sh) - specs/150 D4

(CSP) - style-src 'unsafe-inline' accepted (specs/151 D2: Sonner and TipTap inject <style>, sanitised HTML carries style attributes); script-src stays 'self'. The exact policy is pinned by verify-storefront-image.sh, so any other loosening fails there
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set) - fixed by #294 (specs/151), must not come back
(Modern Web Application) - Informational: a single-page app has no links for the spider; says nothing about security
(Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre Vulnerability) - fixed by #294 (specs/151), must not come back
